title: Restart Degeneration of the Swing Filter and a Simple Repair
summary: The Swing filter extends a feasible line through its previous recording and restarts from a fitted value at the last accepted sample. We show that this inherited endpoint causes a singular loss of compression on rough input. For uniformly sampled Brownian motion at fixed tolerance, every fixed number of recording times converges to the first continuous feasibility boundary, with alternating boundary errors.
